entries.name: Village
entries.content:
The orc village was an imposing, rugged sight, nestled between a towering mountain range and a dense, untamed forest. It was a sprawl of crudely built structures; huts crafted from sturdy logs and layered with thick animal skins for insulation.

The heart of the village was a large open space, the communal ground where all major events were held. A massive bonfire pit was etched into the center, its charred remnants hinting at the roaring fires and boisterous gatherings that took place there.

Urza's hut, the largest in the village, stood at the far end of this open space, overlooking the rest of the settlement. Made from the tallest and thickest logs, it was adorned with various trophies from her victories – animal skulls, enemy weapons, and the like. A massive throne, hewn from a single block of wood, dominated the interior. A large, worn-out rug made from the hide of a great beast was spread out before it, a testament to her prowess as a hunter.
